COLLAR print card
====================================================
blank            44.0 mm dia x 3.80 mm, 0.50 mm edge break
inlay depth      1.20 mm  (6 layers at 0.20)
edge             square groove
                 15 reeds, 1.65 mm deep, 4.10 mm wide, pitch 9.22 mm
rim band         3.50 mm full thickness in slot 3

filament map
  slot 1  #ffffff  black      3.20 cm3  ~4.07 g
  slot 2  #000000  cream      0.30 cm3  ~0.38 g
  slot 3  #ff4d00  orange     1.55 cm3  ~1.97 g
  total                        5.06 cm3  ~6.42 g

insert pocket
  26.0 mm wide for a 25.0 mm tag, 0.60 mm tall
  floor Z 1.60   ceiling Z 2.20
  floor wall 0.40 mm   roof wall 0.40 mm

pause to drop the tag in
  pause before the layer starting Z 2.20 mm, layer 12
  Preview tab, vertical layer slider, right click the plus dot, Add pause.
  Greyed out unless print order is by layer not by object, and unless
  the cursor is on the plus dot itself.

slicing notes
  layer height 0.20 mm, no supports, no brim
  ironing on for the top surface so the colour seams read as one face
  the back face is the bed side, so a smooth plate gives a glossy back
  turn off arc fitting on the outer wall or the reeds get smoothed away
  back face art is mirrored in the model on purpose: it is read from the
  other side once you flip the coin, so it looks backwards in a bottom view

mesh             98746 triangles, 8 slabs, 0.086 mm grid
